newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty closes softer vs basket, depos down.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty closes softer vs basket, depos down.

text.p: 1200 GMT - Polish zloty slides on exporter bids to 2.02/1.97 pct from the trading band centre vs Thursday's 2.19/2.14 pct after hitting an intraday high at over 2.20 pct.
* Zloty at 2.8140/50 to the dollar, down from 2.8095/05 on Thursday and at 1.8385/00 to the mark, down from 1.8335/50.
* O/N dip to 18.15/18.70 pct vs Thursday's 18.70/18.95 pct as banks tried to place surplus cash for the week-end.
* T/N down to 18.50/18.80 pct from 19.80/19.05 pct despite a 686 million zloty 14-day drainage.
